macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: US Treasury steps in to calm bond market as long-term yields hit multi-decade highs
items.summary: The Treasury Department signaled it may intervene more aggressively, and Reuters-linked reporting says it will double liquidity-support buyback operations for longer-dated bonds after the 30-year Treasury yield spiked to around 5.33%, its highest level since 2007. The move helped pull long yields lower and eased pressure on markets.

items.title: Dollar weakens as Treasury bond-market support lifts risk assets
items.summary: The U.S. dollar hovered near three-month lows after the Treasury announced steps to support the long-end bond market. The 10-year Treasury yield fell and the 30-year yield dropped sharply following the announcement.

items.title: US stock futures steady after bond yields retreat; Wall Street watches retailers and oil
items.summary: U.S. stock futures were little changed to slightly higher after Treasury yields eased on the bond-market intervention news. Market focus remained on retail earnings, rising oil prices, and geopolitical risk tied to Iran.

items.title: Walmart earnings headline the corporate calendar
items.summary: Walmart is a key earnings report in focus, with analysts expecting solid results but slower sales growth. The report is being watched for clues on U.S. consumer spending.

items.title: U.S. retail sales fall sharply, adding to growth concerns
items.summary: Retail sales dropped 0.6% in July from the prior month, the steepest decline since May 2025. The weaker consumer data has reinforced market attention on the pace of economic growth.

items.title: Fed minutes show renewed debate over rate hikes
items.summary: MarketWatch reports that Fed minutes showed growing support for rate hikes, while other coverage said officials remained divided on the inflation outlook. The takeaway is that the Federal Reserve is still split on whether policy needs to tighten further.

items.title: July Fed meeting minutes highlight inflation-risk divide
items.summary: The Hindu BusinessLine reported that three officials favored a 25-basis-point rate increase at the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, even though the committee left rates unchanged. The minutes underscored persistent concern about inflation risks.

items.title: Global equities hold gains as U.S. inflation meets expectations
items.summary: Global stocks held onto gains after July U.S. CPI matched forecasts, with annual inflation easing to 3.4% from 3.5%. Markets continued to price a meaningful chance that the Fed keeps rates unchanged at the next meeting.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether surge after Trump urges Congress to pass crypto bill
items.summary: Bitcoin, ether, and other major cryptocurrencies rallied after U.S. President Donald Trump called on Congress to pass legislation expected to benefit the sector. Hyperliquid also jumped about 20% over 24 hours after Trump mentioned potential regulation for the fast-growing decentralized exchange.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks above $68,000 as crypto market spikes
items.summary: Bitcoin rose more than 5% in 24 hours and traded above $68,000 for the first time since June, with broader crypto markets following higher. The move came amid improving sentiment around U.S. regulatory developments and macro conditions.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $71,000 as leverage wipeout exceeds $3 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed to above $71,600, while Ethereum, XRP, and Solana posted double-digit gains in a broad crypto rally. CoinGlass data cited in coverage showed roughly $3.3 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in 24 hours, mostly short positions.

items.title: SEC proposes new crypto asset investment contract rules
items.summary: The SEC proposed a new framework for crypto asset investment contracts, adding momentum to the day’s regulatory news. Coverage says the proposal includes registration exemptions for eligible crypto startups and issuers under a new 'Regulation Crypto Assets' approach.

items.title: South Korea confirms 22% crypto tax will cover private wallets and foreign exchanges
items.summary: South Korea clarified that its 22% crypto tax regime will apply to private wallets and foreign exchanges, tightening the tax scope for local users. The announcement was among the key regulatory updates reported in the last 24 hours.

items.title: Bitcoin.com adds UAE-registered dollar stablecoin to self-custodial wallet
items.summary: Bitcoin.com integrated a UAE-registered U.S. dollar stablecoin into its self-custodial wallet, expanding stablecoin support. The move adds to ongoing product development across crypto wallet infrastructure.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI slows training after AI-security incident and new teen safeguards
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly paused or slowed frontier model training while it reviews security practices after an incident involving its AI system. It also introduced a ChatGPT for Teens update with parental controls and stronger age-appropriate safeguards.

items.title: Multiple new AI models launched in a crowded August release cycle
items.summary: A recent roundup says August has already seen eleven new AI model releases from seven providers, including updated Gemini, Grok, Meta, ByteDance, and Z.AI models. The pace of releases is outstripping public testing and evaluation capacity.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with parental controls
items.summary: OpenAI rolled out a teen-focused version of ChatGPT with parental controls, study tools, quiet hours, and stronger safeguards for users ages 13 to 17. The change reflects growing industry focus on youth safety and age-appropriate AI use.

items.title: OpenAI pauses frontier reinforcement learning amid safety concerns
items.summary: Reports say OpenAI has slowed or paused parts of frontier reinforcement learning and broader model training while it evaluates safety and alignment risks. The move adds to a broader industry trend of companies balancing rapid model development with stronger security controls.

items.title: Unitree Robotics surges after Shanghai IPO
items.summary: Chinese robotics company Unitree made a strong market debut, with reports citing a major surge in its stock price after the IPO. The listing underscores investor enthusiasm for AI-adjacent robotics and embodied AI hardware.

items.title: OpenAI introduces new privacy protections for enterprise customers
items.summary: A report says OpenAI is planning enhanced privacy protections aimed at enterprise customers as it competes more directly with Anthropic and other model providers. The development points to privacy and data governance becoming a major product differentiator in AI.

items.title: Stripe reportedly moves to acquire OpenRouter in AI push
items.summary: Financial news coverage says Stripe is preparing to buy OpenRouter as part of a broader push into AI infrastructure and developer tooling. If completed, the deal would signal continued consolidation in AI platform and middleware markets.

items.title: Google gives free 1-year Gemini AI plans to students
items.summary: Google is reportedly offering students a free one-year Gemini AI plan, expanding its education-focused distribution strategy. The move reflects intensifying competition among major AI vendors for student and classroom adoption.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: GTA 6 leak videos spread online as more footage emerges
items.summary: Multiple reports say new gameplay clips from an alleged playable build of Grand Theft Auto VI surfaced within the last 24 hours, with one outlet noting a fourth video and another warning of more breaches to come. Rockstar has not publicly confirmed the authenticity of the leaked material.
items.source: India Today / Times Now / The Shortcut

items.title: Mortal Shell II lands with strong pre-release buzz
items.summary: A gaming industry newsletter says Mortal Shell II arrived today and is generating significant attention ahead of release. The same roundup also listed STALKER 2: Cost of Hope and STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT as newly available titles.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass adds a new August 2026 Wave 2 lineup
items.summary: Xbox announced a large second wave of August 2026 Game Pass additions, including Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy for Ultimate and PC subscribers. The lineup also includes multiple indie and day-one releases.

items.title: Esports Nations Cup delayed until 2027
items.summary: A gaming industry roundup reports that the inaugural Esports Nations Cup has been pushed back a year because of the wider regional situation, delaying what was meant to be a new international esports event on the calendar.

items.title: Sony plans to end PlayStation disc production in 2028
items.summary: Push Square reports that Sony has stated it intends to stop producing game discs for PlayStation consoles starting in 2028, signaling a long-term shift toward digital distribution.

items.title: Valve expands SteamOS support beyond Valve hardware
items.summary: Ars Technica reports that Valve has released another update improving SteamOS support on non-Valve devices, including the Intel-based MSI Claw 8 EX AI+.

items.title: Netflix closes two game studios
items.summary: The Verge reports that Netflix is shutting down two game studios, including Night School Studio despite its positive reception for Unhinged, adding to broader gaming-industry restructuring news.

items.title: New Quake mission pack celebrates the franchise’s 30th anniversary
items.summary: Ars Technica says an official new Quake mission pack has launched with fresh maps and mechanics as part of the series’ 30th anniversary celebrations.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.
